name: Stop Falling For It!
author: Sjet, Sungbin
bootlegger: The Poppy Grower does not know they are the Poppy Grower. They believe they are a different good character, but they are actually the Poppy Grower. The Poppy Grower is always in play, and the Storm Catcher always selects the Poppy Grower.
The Kazali chooses Minion players and characters, but who becomes which character is arbitrary. After the Kazali finishes choosing, put the Kazali to sleep before creating the Minions.
The Typhon learns who the Minions are at the start of the game.
